# Marafei Golf

Marafei Golf (https://golf.marafei.net) is the golf simulator practice of Marafei (https://marafei.net / https://marafei.com).

## What we do
We sell, design, and install indoor golf simulators across Saudi Arabia and the GCC (Gulf). We are an authorized TrackMan dealer and a BenQ golf projector partner. We also integrate SportsBox AI and Smart2Move.

## Who we serve
Private residences, golf academies (including work for Golf Saudi at Riyadh Golf Club VIP Academy), hotels, resorts, and commercial entertainment venues.

## Where
Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, NEOM, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, and the wider Middle East.
